title: Sheet
description: Makes its host a trigger for a notes panel: a click opens a resizable sheet from the left edge with a title and either the given content or a notes textarea, and drag on its edge resizes it between its minimum and maximum width. It applies to any clickable element, so it names no host.

sheetTitle.description: The sheet's heading. Named sheet-title, not title, so the trigger keeps its own native title tooltip; heading= is read too.

sheetContent.description: The sheet's body (HTML). Empty gives a notes textarea. description= is read too.

width.description: The sheet's opening width (any CSS length).

minWidth.description: The narrowest a drag can make the sheet.
minWidth.visualReason: Only bounds a drag on the resize edge; the sheet opens at width either way.

maxWidth.description: The widest a drag can make the sheet.
maxWidth.visualReason: Only bounds a drag on the resize edge; the sheet opens at width either way.

setup: <button x-sheet sheet-title="Wide notes" width="420px">Open wide notes</button>
